title: Almost Every Graph Is Reconstructible from Its Token Graphs
summary: Let $F_k(G)$ denote the $k$-token graph of a finite graph $G$. The token graph reconstruction conjecture asks whether, for any $1\le k<|V(G)|$, $F_k(G)\cong F_k(H)$ implies $G\cong H$. This paper proves that the conjecture holds for almost every graph.
